threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still cringe when the bus driver calls you 'darling'—the locals consider it standard fare. Embrace it, or you'll stand out.
Heard a guy on the 3 bus last night ranting about how the tube strike ruined his plans to find the best jollof rice in SE24. He had a whole list.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a guy in a full tuxedo buying a döner at 3 AM near Hermannplatz. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a random open-air gallery in the middle of a parking lot, showcasing local artists' work while people grab a döner next door.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by their instinct to avoid BART delays; they won't even sweat it when a train’s brakes are on the fritz. It's a daily hustle.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week, a tourist tried to pay with a donut in the Muni bus. Driver just shrugged, took it, and smiled. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but they're missing the real magic in the tiny bars that serve homemade vermut.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they approach the metro ticket machines, fumbling with coins like they’re encrypting a treasure map.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for a ‘cuppa’ at the local café instead of just ordering a flat white like everyone else. They look at you funny.
Caught a glimpse of a guy trying to impress a girl by reciting Shakespeare on the 36. He got off at Camberwell, still trying to woo her.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I stumbled upon a street market selling homemade sauerkraut and vinyl records, I knew Neukölln had woven itself into my soul.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you see kids riding their scooters in the U-Bahn while parents sip coffee, completely unbothered by the chaos around them.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know the real trick: you tap your Clipper card twice at BART, or else you're stuck waiting another 20 minutes with the tourists.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, I saw a guy nap on a Muni bus, headphones in, completely oblivious as it rolled past his stop. Classic SF vibe—lost in the chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the locals are all about the Sagrada Família. Most of us would rather discuss the latest vermut bars in Poble Sec.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still stand at the crosswalks staring at their maps, oblivious to the impatience of the locals zigzagging around them.
